description: This file declares functions and includes necessary headers for MPU (Memory Protection Unit) utility operations in a hardware layer setup for STM32F1 microcontrollers. It defines an initialization function for SPI chip select control and includes macros related to hardware initialization.

methods.name: baseHardwareInit
methods.description: A macro for hardware initialization, currently defined as an empty function.

methods.name: initSpiCs
methods.description: Function to initialize the SPI chip select pin with a given SPI configuration.
